must_identify.item: The api Service has no endpoints
must_identify.evidence: the Service had no matching backend endpoints, as confirmed by `kubectl get endpoints api -n shop` returning `<none>` and the associated EndpointSlice showing `endpoints: null` [10, 15, 17].

must_identify.item: Its selector (app=api-v2) does not match the pod labels (app=api)
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a label/selector mismatch on the `api` Service in the `shop` namespace: the Deployment and its pods are labeled `app=api` [13, 18] ... No competing `app=api-v2` workload was found to justify an intentional selector pointing elsewhere [19]

notes: The RCA never states the selector value as app=api-v2. That value is only implied through the 'api-v2 workload' references, so a reviewer may want to downgrade the second item to partial. The RCA mentions a 'proposed selector patch' but never gives the target value app=api, so no explicit fix is stated.
